entries.name: Snow Villiers
entries.sourceReference: Snow’s original Commando full-ATB skill Sovereign Fist: forward approach, upward leap and one descending physical fist impact with a ground shock; no gun or Shiva transformation.

visualValidation.notes: Original Snow costume: black knit cap, pale blond hair, tan long coat, dark shirt/trousers, blue plaid cloth, gloves and boots. Sovereign Fist finale and super both show a leap and descending fist. Any dust/shock ring is a compact native visual adaptation, not a claim about runtime target count.
visualValidation.reviewMethod: All 32 native source poses and the final normalized contact sheet inspected for original XIII identity, age, outfit, weapons, grid placement and specific full-ATB choreography.

entries.name: Sazh Katzroy
entries.sourceReference: Sazh’s original Ravager full-ATB skill Cold Blood: a long alternating dual-pistol gunfire volley building the target’s chain, adapted to four poses; no Eidolon or vehicle substitution.

visualValidation.notes: Original adult Sazh with afro, moustache/goatee, long green coat, pale shirt, brown trousers and boots. Two original-game pistols are visible in both Cold Blood sequences. The small chocobo chick remains an incidental companion, never a projectile or source of damage.

entries.name: Hope Estheim
entries.sourceReference: Hope’s original Ravager full-ATB skill Last Resort: a volley of non-elemental magical blasts launched upward then raining down on targets, with the original adolescent and his Airwing boomerang retained; not Alexander.

visualValidation.notes: Original adolescent Hope, silver hair, orange/yellow short jacket over black/white torso, teal scarf, olive cropped trousers and boots. Airwing remains his physical boomerang. Last Resort is an offensive airborne magical volley with descending motes, not healing, an Eidolon, a giant sword or a physical boomerang-finisher substitution.
